name: Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24
tagline: Self levelling high build epoxy floor system - smooth or finely textured
summary: Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24 is a smooth or finely textured pigmented 2-3 mm floor.
metaDescription: Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24 is a smooth or finely textured pigmented 2-3 mm floor.
usage: Food and Beverage Facilities - mainly dry packaging areas

items.text: ~35 mg (CS 10/1000/1000) (7 days / +23 °C) | (DIN 53 109 Taber Abraser Test)

items.text: ~ 50 N/mm2 ( Resin filled 1:0,9 with F34 at 28 days / +23 °C) | (EN 196-1)

items.text: ~ 16 N/mm2 ( Resin filled 1:0,9 with F34 at 28 days / +23 °C) | (EN 196-1)

items.text: > 1.5 N/mm² (failure in concrete) | (ISO 4624)

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika technical service for specific advice.

items.label: Temperature resistance
items.text:
Exposure* | Dry heat
Permanent | +50 °C
Short-term max. 7 d | +80 °C
Short-term max. 12 h | +100 °C
Short-term moist/wet heat* up to +80 °C where exposure is only occasional (steam cleaning etc.). *No simultaneous chemical and mechanical exposure.

items.label: Material temperature
items.text: Please refer to the individual Product Data Sheet

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Relative air humidity
items.text: 80 % r.h. max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text:
When performing application work with Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24, the substrate moisture content must not exceed 4 % pbw measured by Tramex. Test method: Sika®-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene-sheet).
Use Sikafloor 161 Primer for moisture to 6%pbw.
For >6%pbw use Sikafloor EpoCem 81.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Before applying Sikafloor®-263 SL on Sikafloor®-156/-161/-160 allow:
Substrate Temperature | Minimum | Maximum
+10 °C | 24 hours | 3 days
+20 °C | 12 hours | 2 days
+30 °C | 8 hours | 1 day

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Temperature | Foot Traffic | Light Traffic | Full Cure
+10 °C | ~72 hours | ~6 days | ~10 days
+20 °C | ~24 hours | ~4 days | ~7 days
+30 °C | ~18 hours | ~2 days | ~5 days

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Coating System | Product | Consumption
Primer Scratch coat (If required) | 1 × Sikafloor®-160/-161 Sikafloor®-161 filled 1:0.5 filler 503 | ~ 0.25–0.35 kg/m² 1 kg/m²
Wearing coat | 1 x Sikafloor®-263 SL 2 and 3mm comprising of 1kg of Sikafloor®-264 and 1kg of filler 503 | ~ 1.9kg/m²/mm
Finish coat - optional | Sikafloor 264/-264T AU | ~ 0.20–0.30 kg/m²
UV stable Topcoat | Sikafloor 359 AU | 6-8 m²/litre
Note: For addtional texture, incorporate 60 mesh size alumimium oxide at 5-6% by vol. into finish coat.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text:
Substrate be free of contaminants.
Refer to individual Sikafloor 161/263SL and 264T AU TDS.
25Mpa - Cohesive bond pull off value of >1.5 mpa.
Note; Bond tests should be conducted to confirm the suitability of the substrate.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Surfaces should be clean, dry and free of contaminants.
Prepared surface should produce a cohesive bond pull off value of min.1.5Mpa. and a moisture level of <4%pbw.
All unsound layers of laitance and any existing coatings are to be removed.
Self smoothing layers of Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24 will not re profile irregularities in the concrete surface.
Profile and defects greater than approx.1.5-2mm will require re-levelling.
This can be achieved using Sikafloor 160/161 mortars and or scratch filling layers.
For application of Sikafloor® MultiDur ES-24 over existing resin finishes, refer to Sika Technical Dept. for direction.
